evidence.reason: AE-08 phase 8 step 6b (E3, in-place portable seek): a paused locate moves the kept session in place, so ensurePrepared keeps the position check on a three-line prelude (arm 458 anchors move with it; the mutant keeps its meaning: answer started at the old position without a seek). The witnesses that held a compile or a re-prepare for the paused locate are renamed to what they now hold: B6f5 F (a paused locate in flight instead of a re-prepare), B6f2 two paused locates (the first seek held at its stop transport instead of a held compile). The matrix arms 484 and 485 lose the paused-reprepare-postcompile cells, which the paused locate no longer reaches. Arm 497 (liveAdoption fingerprint write) is reachable again through a seek: its witness is B6f5 a resume after an adoption and a paused locate plays the newest state on the same session, and its test filter includes it. See PHASE8-STEP6B-E3.md.
